definitions.explanation: A question word asking to identify one item from a group of three or more. Used when choices are not directly attached to nouns.

examples.japanese: あなたのかばんはどれですか？
どれが{一番|いちばん}{好|す}きですか？
examples.english: Which one do you like the best?

examples.notes: どれでも = any one (of them)

notes: Used for choosing among three or more items. For two items, use どちら (dochira). Part of the こそあど series: これ (this one), それ (that one), あれ (that one over there), どれ (which one).
